verdict.summary: The workflow changes consistently gate rust-cache saves to the main ref while leaving restores enabled, and the pull-request-only mutation lane is explicitly exempted because it has no main-ref run capable of seeding its automatic job cache. The structural test widens discovery to pull_request/merge_group workflows, pins representative inclusion and exclusion cases, checks every discovered rust-cache step, and validates the exemption's current trigger and key configuration. The focused unittest suite passes. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found in the diff.
